name: Ember Pepper
description: Hot enough to toast bread. Do not keep it in a back pocket.

name: Frost Mint
description: So cooling that sniffing it counts as a short holiday.

name: Sunpetal
description: Turns towards whoever is talking. Mends things. Likes compliments.

name: Nightshade Cap
description: A mushroom that sighs when picked. Brings sleep and the spooky sort of dark.

name: Honeycomb
description: A little warmth, a lot of healing. The bees would like a receipt.

name: Moonmoss
description: Grows on north-facing gravestones, tough as old boots. Grind it: a touch of calm, a lot of spooky.

name: Cinderroot
description: A root that smoulders in the soil. It only gives up its fire to a roaring flame: pump the bellows.

name: Snowfire Pearl
description: Warm on one side, frosty on the other. Oysters argue about which side is up.

name: Twilight Bloom
description: Opens at dusk, yawns at dawn. Half healing, half bedtime story.

name: Starlight Dew
description: Dew that froze while a star was watching. Grind the crystals: calm, growth and a hint of night.
